newsitem.title: USA: Citizens/First Southern say to merge.
newsitem.headline: Citizens/First Southern say to merge.

text.p: Citizens Bancshares Corp, parent company of Citizens Trust Bank, and First Southern Bancshares Inc, parent company of First Southern Bank and FSB Mortgage Services Inc, said on Monday they signed a letter of intent to merge.

The merger, expected to be complete by year end, will create the third largest African-American owned commercial bank in the United States, with assets of about $200 million, a news release issued by the companies said.
Citizens Trust founded in 1921, has assets of $137 million, eight locations, and 148 employees, the news release said.

First Southern, founded in 1987, has assets of $59 million, three locations, and 41 employees, while FSB Mortgage Services, which was purchased by First Southern in September of 1996, has 20 employees, the news release said.
